skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the concept, characteristics, and lifecycle of projects
Understand the role and importance of project management
Understand the role and responsibilities of a project manager
Understand the role and functions of a project office
Apply project management concepts to analyze, evaluate, and handle situations in project execution
Understand and use WBS techniques for project tasks
Understand and use techniques for estimating time and cost of projects
Understand and use techniques for selecting partners and negotiating contracts
Understand and use techniques to create project network diagrams
Understand and use techniques to coordinate resources for completing projects

skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and use techniques to control time and costs of projects
